sections.Description:
Fallout by Stern Pinball throws players into the chaotic post-war wasteland inspired by the hit TV series and iconic video game franchise

Experience the show’s story from the perspective of Lucy MacLean, The Ghoul, or Maximus. Enter the Vault to discover the horrors of Vault-Tec’s past, present, and future. Find Wilzig’s head to discover the secrets of Cold Fusion held within.
sections.Gameplay Features:
- Your Very Own PIP-BOY: Fully interactive PIP-BOY playfield LCD, in collaboration with The Wand Company, displays real-time gameplay information and instructions to the player.
- Use the Fat Man Launcher: Multi-Target Shooting Gallery lets players battle Radscorpions (Optical Spinning Target), Ghouls (Flyaway Target) and Raiders (Flip Flop Target) with their Fat Man launcher.
- Collect Bottle Caps: Collect bottle caps, the currency of the apocalypse, by shooting the industry-first Up/Down Vertical Spinning Target. Target face is custom-molded to resemble a genuine Nuka-Cola bottle cap.
sections.Editions:
Pro:
- Utilizing Stern Pinball’s award-winning Insider Connected, Fallout pinball allows players to track their characters' S.P.E.C.I.A.L. stats across games. Players can also track their junk collection as they search the Wasteland.
- Includes the original game soundtrack and sound effects from the hit Bethesda games Fallout 3, Fallout 4, and Fallout: New Vegas.
- Pro Edition translite and side cabinet highlighting the climactic Brotherhood of Steel and New California Republic battle at Griffith Observatory.

Premium:
- Powder-coated steel bottom arch.
- Includes the original game soundtrack and sound effects from the hit Bethesda games Fallout 3, Fallout 4, and Fallout: New Vegas.
- Premium Edition translite and side cabinet highlighting Maximus's showdown against the Deathclaws of New Vegas.

Limited Edition:
- Custom Vault-Tec Yellow powder-coated legs, hinges, Action Button front molding and laser-cut illuminated pinball armor.
- Interactive Speaker Expression Lighting System with Vault-Tec themed, laser-cut shapes and themed game effects.
- Interactive Cabinet Expression Lighting System™ with intelligent full-color spectrum RGB LEDs; synchronized & responsive to game events.
